subject: [hw] DONE P03 rev 1 (R2 F26 fixed)
body:
Rev 1 of DONE P03: R2 finding F26 (low) fixed, no code change. Everything else from the first DONE stands.

  bash gpu/hwcodec/client/test/run_tests.sh
  -> N2TEST P03 PASS 526/526
(171/171 in ASan+UBSan -O1, 171/171 -O2, 171/171 TSan -O1; 12/12 the real n2vcd_cli end to end against a scripted daemon; 1/1 arm64-apple-ios16.0 compile gate with -Werror; ~10 s; /tmp/n2hw-P03.)

F26: client/n2vcd_client.h and client/README.md no longer say "vcodecd exits ... launchd restarts it". They now state only the client rule: E_GUEST / a vanished server is session-fatal, close, fall back to software for that session, retry with a fresh n2vcd_connect() at the next StartSession, never reuse the old client. Commit a5415cd (STATUS commits 82dff29).

Commits: 1908a5a (package), 19c7b5e (connect_path/status_errno helpers for P04), a5415cd (F26), 82dff29 (STATUS). Files: client/** only plus dsh-state/workers/P03/STATUS.md.

Not done (unchanged, honest list in client/STATUS.md): no phone run (recording-ioctl tests only for relay/hardware); n2vc_hw.regs has no poll-timeout parameter (1 s default documented); client/n2vcd_server.c is an alternative to daemon/n2vcd_srv.c, not an addition (same symbols); CLI is H.264 only and no decoder API exists; enc_frame requires cap >= session out_bytes; a second OPEN after E_BUSY is not auto-retried.

Integration evidence: hw-ips vcodecd suite with this CLI, OUTPUT redirected to my /tmp, N2TEST IP PASS 717/717; vcodecd arm64-ios links with the 3 IV symbols added to their sdk_symbols.txt (271504 B NOUNDEFS). Staying available for R2 and the lead.
